headlines.title: 반도체·원화 강세에 1인당 GNI 4만달러 눈앞 …체감소득은 '온도 차'
headlines.summary: [인천=뉴시스] 전진환 기자 = 한국은행은 반도체 수출 호조에 힘입어 2분기 실질 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률(직전분기대비·잠정치)이 0.6%로 집계됐다고 8일 밝혔다. 분기 성장률은 지난해 1분기 역성장(-0.2%) 이후 2분기 0.6%, 3분기 1.4% 등으로 개선되다가 4분기 -0.1%로 다시 하락한 뒤 올해 반등했다.

headlines.title: 명목GDP 26.4% ↑… 47년만 최고

headlines.title: ‘ 국민소득 4만불 ’ 1년 당긴 한은 ...‘반도체·환율’에 이례적 자신감...
headlines.summary: 연초 2028년 달성 전망서 시점 앞당겨 반도체 주도 총영업잉여 증가폭 최고치 환율 안정 GNI 4만달러 전망에 힘 보태 한국은행이 올해 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)가 4만달러를 넘길 것이라고 자신한 배경에는 인공지능(AI) 산업과 관련해 전 세계적으로 치솟고 있는 반도체 수요가 꼽힌다.

headlines.title: 추석 코 앞인데 … 한우 ‘ 등심 1+ ’ 1년새 34% 올라
headlines.summary: 사육·도축 동반감소에 명절수요 겹쳐 등심1+, 5분기 연속 상승 ‘고공 행진’ 美 척아이롤 21%↑…수입산도 부담 추석을 앞두고 소고기 가격이 가파른 상승세를 보이고 있다. 한우 사육 마릿수와 도축 물량이 줄어 공급이 감소한 데다 추석 성수기 수요까지 겹친 영향이다. 상대적으로 저렴한 수입 소고기 가격도 오르면서 장바구니 부담이 가중되는 모습이다.

headlines.title: 기상 여건 호조에 봄 감자 생산량 5천t 증가한 36만1천t
headlines.summary: 감자 [연합뉴스 자료사진. 재판매 및 DB 금지] (세종=연합뉴스) 김수현 기자 = 올해 기상 여건이 양호했던 영향으로 봄 감자 생산량이 늘었다. 국가데이터처가 8일 발표한 '2026년 봄 감자 생산량 조사 결과'를 보면 올해 봄 감자 생산량은 36만1천t으로, 작년보다 5천t(1.5%) 늘었다.

headlines.title: 서울시 “ 계약 연장·분양전환 없다 ”… 장기전세 9300호 재공급
headlines.summary: 일부 계약연장 요구에 ‘불가’ 원칙 재확인 오세훈 “다음 무주택자 기회로 이어져야” 만기 물량은 청년·신혼부부 등에 공급 서울시가 내년 20년 만기가 도래하는 장기전세주택 310호를 시작으로 2031년까지 총 9300호를 순차적으로 반환받아 신규 입주민에게 재공급한다.

headlines.title: 서울 아파트 경매 식었다는데 … 중랑·노원은 ‘ 불장 ’
headlines.summary: 8월 낙찰가율 97%로 전달보다 4%P 하락 중랑 115.2%·노원 102.8%, 중저가 후끈 전문가 “하락장땐 외곽 소형부터 조정” 경계 서울 아파트 경매 낙찰가율이 한 달 새 4%포인트 떨어지는 등 전반적으로 부진한 흐름을 보이고 있지만, 외곽지역에서는 감정가를 크게 웃도는 가격에 낙찰되는 사례가 이어지고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부 도 ‘ 영끌 ?’… 5000억 들여 수도권 주택 용지 매입
headlines.summary: ■ 공공토지 비축 매입 공모 29일부터 매각신청 접수받아 경기 광주역세권 2지구로 공개된 장지동 일대 모습. 연합뉴스 정부가 5000억 원을 들여 공공토지 매입에 나선다. 수도권 주택 수요에 대응하기 위해 도심 주택용지로 활용할 수 있는 유휴부지를 미리 마련하기 위해서다.

headlines.title: 관세청, 올해 7개월간 탈세·법규 위반 1조760억원 적발

key_headlines.title: Nominal GDP Growth Hits 47-Year High, Per Capita GNI Approaching $40,000
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's nominal GDP growth reached its highest level in 47 years in Q2 2026, driven primarily by semiconductor exports. The Bank of Korea projects per capita GNI will exceed $40,000 this year, accelerating the timeline by approximately 2 years.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Fuels Record National Income and Economic Confidence
key_headlines.summary: Real GNI surged 15.6%, the largest increase in 37.5 years, as improved trade conditions centered on semiconductors boosted national income to a record 666.8 trillion won. AI-driven global semiconductor demand continues to strengthen Korea's economic outlook.

key_headlines.title: Seoul City to Redeploy 9,300 Long-Term Jeonse Units Starting Next Year
key_headlines.summary: Seoul announced plans to reacquire and redeploy 9,300 long-term jeonse (deposit rent) apartments between 2026 and 2031, beginning with 310 units maturing next year. The city ruled out contract extensions or conversion to sales, prioritizing young and newly married couples.

key_headlines.title: Trump Retaliates Against Canadian Tariffs, Excludes Canadian Products from $500 Billion Federal Procurement
key_headlines.summary: President Trump instructed the U.S. General Services Administration to exclude Canadian products from federal procurement contracts in response to Canada's $20 billion retaliatory tariff on American goods. The trade conflict between the two nations intensifies with maximum tariff rates reaching 50%.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Considers October Rate Hike as Semiconductor-Driven Growth Raises Policy Questions
key_headlines.summary: Amid strong nominal GDP growth driven by semiconductors, the Bank of Korea faces mounting pressure for consecutive rate increases. The central bank emphasized that nominal GDP serves as an important monetary policy indicator, with September inflation data emerging as a key variable for policy decisions.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing robust growth driven primarily by the semiconductor sector, with nominal GDP expanding at a 47-year high rate and real GDP growing 0.6% quarter-over-quarter. The nation is on track to achieve per capita GNI of $40,000 this year, accelerating previous projections by approximately two years. Semiconductor exports, bolstered by global AI demand, have significantly improved Korea's trade conditions and corporate profits. However, this exceptional growth has created complex challenges for monetary policy, with the Bank of Korea weighing whether to proceed with consecutive rate increases despite strong nominal growth indicators.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Q2 nominal GDP growth of 26.4% represents the highest increase in 47 years, while real GDP grew 0.6% quarter-over-quarter, unchanged from preliminary estimates. Real GNI surged 15.6%, marking the largest increase in 37.5 years, driven by semiconductor-led improvements in trade conditions and currency stability. The Bank of Korea projects per capita GNI will exceed $40,000 in 2026, two years ahead of earlier forecasts, citing semiconductor dominance in operating surplus increases. However, the central bank faces mounting pressure regarding potential October rate increases, with considerations for consecutive hikes creating policy uncertainty amid strong nominal growth but modest real growth.
sections.Financial Markets: Global investors are shifting away from U.S. Treasury bonds and rotating into equities, with increased volatility in bond markets reflecting concerns about rising long-term rates driven by hyperscaler AI investments. Domestic financial institutions are positioned to benefit from combined tailwinds of rising interest rates and weak won conditions, with financial holding companies expected to post record Q3 earnings. U.S. Treasury selloffs by overseas investors are dampening risk asset sentiment globally, while short-duration U.S. Treasury ETFs are gaining popularity among retail investors amid worldwide rate increase concerns. The yen carry unwinding remains a concern as the dollar-yen rate approaches 152 yen, with expectations for Japanese rate increases adding to market volatility.
sections.Industry & Technology: Hyundai Motor is strengthening its battery business capabilities to counter Chinese EV competition, complementing weaker price competitiveness with enhanced safety advantages. South Chungcheong Province is developing a 1.2 trillion won AI data center in Dangjin to establish itself as an 'AI capital,' leveraging stable power supply and technical expertise. Nuclear power stocks are attracting investor attention as 2040 power demand projections were revised upward by 26.6GW, necessitating increased non-renewable energy capacity alongside renewables and battery storage. Copper prices have surged 47% over the past year to record highs due to widespread industrial demand in semiconductors, EVs, renewable energy infrastructure, and power transmission systems.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's real estate market is bifurcating, with strong demand persisting in northern Seoul and southern Gyeonggi regions despite weakening Gangnam property sentiment following tax reform measures. Despite declining Seoul population, property prices continue rising in certain areas, indicating that demographic trends alone do not determine real estate values. Daegu experienced a surge in new apartment jeonse leasing demand with 'open runs' resuming after three months, as buyers seek below-market rental deposit opportunities for newly constructed units. Seoul's jeonse market shows mixed signals, with strong interest in affordable new units contrasting with cooling demand in traditionally premium areas following recent policy changes.
sections.International Economy: The U.S.-Canada trade conflict escalated dramatically as President Trump instructed federal agencies to exclude Canadian products from $50 billion annual procurement contracts in response to Canada's $20 billion retaliatory tariff. Canada imposed maximum 50% tariffs on American goods including steel, aluminum, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, and electronics following U.S. tariff measures. The escalating protectionism reflects growing trade tensions and threatens broader economic cooperation between neighboring economies. Upcoming U.S. inflation data (September PPI and CPI) and the Federal Reserve's September 15-16 FOMC meeting are expected to significantly impact global markets and tariff policy trajectories.
sections.AI & Economy: KB Securities highlights that intensifying global AI model competition will dramatically increase memory semiconductor demand, particularly benefiting Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Naver's announced 10 trillion won AI data center investment marks a strategic shift toward asset ownership by financial capital with operational management by specialized entities, addressing the next phase of AI infrastructure financing challenges. The Ministry of Employment and Labor launched a 'Green Paper Discussion Forum on New Social Contracts for the AI Era' to address employment, labor forms, social safety nets, and profit-sharing arrangements required by AI transformation. Gaon Wire achieved its first Canadian market entry with public power grid contracts, expanding North American operations beyond private AI data centers and semiconductor facilities.
sections.Others: The South Korean and French governments are fostering bilateral cooperation in strategic industries including AI, quantum computing, and advanced manufacturing, combining French foundational technology with Korean semiconductor and manufacturing capabilities. LG Electronics is expanding collaboration with Renault on high-performance batteries, vehicle solutions, and automotive software, with additional health and beauty sector opportunities under discussion. Cosmetics export company Cosmax is leveraging Korea's position as the world's second-largest cosmetics exporter to strengthen bilateral partnerships. Pleeto introduced an AI-powered multilingual translation solution for workplace safety in cooperation with the Korean Industrial Safety Association, targeting migrant workers through the employment permit system.
